t.zh: 这里线上流动的值大多是<wiki-ref to="vector"></wiki-ref>：从原点出发的一支箭头，也是一列数，写出箭头尖的坐标。下图是 (2, 1)。
t.en: Most values on these wires are <wiki-ref to="vector"></wiki-ref>s: an arrow from the origin, and a column of numbers giving the coordinates of its tip. Below is (2, 1).

t.zh: 两段位移接着走，第二支箭头从第一支的箭头尖出发；从起点指到终点的那一支，就是它们的<wiki-ref to="vector-sum"></wiki-ref>。<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>把两支箭头相加。
t.en: Two moves one after the other: the second arrow starts at the tip of the first, and the arrow from the start to the end is their <wiki-ref to="vector-sum"></wiki-ref>. <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> adds two arrows.

showcase.zh: 第一次往板上放元件、接线：元件放在输入和输出之间，一块元件的输出可以接进下一块
showcase.en: the first parts placed and wired on a board: a part sits between the inputs and the output, and one part's output can go into the next

after.zh: 向量逐个分量相加；先走哪一段，终点都一样。
after.en: Vectors add entry by entry, and the order of the legs does not change where they end.

brief.zh: u、v、w 三段位移依次走完，交出总位移。
brief.en: Walk the moves u, v and w in turn, and give the whole move.

hint.zh: 一块元件只接两个输入；它的输出可以再接进下一块。
hint.en: A part takes two inputs; its output can go into the next part.

t.zh: 一个点也可以看成从原点指向它的箭头。<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>只能把给定的箭头整段接上；要走到一半，得把箭头缩短。<wiki-ref to="scalar-multiple"></wiki-ref>让箭头沿它所在的直线伸缩，乘的数为负时掉头；<part-ref to="part:num"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数。
t.en: A point can be read as the arrow from the origin to it. <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> can only lay the given arrows end to end, whole; to go halfway, an arrow must be shortened. A <wiki-ref to="scalar-multiple"></wiki-ref> stretches or shrinks an arrow along its own line, turning it round when the number is negative; <part-ref to="part:num"></part-ref> gives a fixed number.

after.zh: 数乘只改变箭头的长短和朝向，不让它离开所在的直线。
after.en: Scaling changes only an arrow's length and sense; it never leaves its line.

brief.zh: 交出 p、q 两点连线的中点。
brief.en: Give the midpoint of the segment from p to q.

hint.zh: 中点的箭头与 p + q 方向相同。
hint.en: The midpoint's arrow points the same way as p + q.

t.zh: 到这里为止的箭头都从原点出发。从一个点指向另一个点的箭头，起点不在原点；元件箱里也没有相减。
t.en: Every arrow so far has started at the origin. An arrow from one point to another does not, and there is no subtracting among the parts.

after.zh: q − p 是从 p 指向 q 的位移：减去一支箭头，就是加上它掉头后的样子。
after.en: q − p is the move from p to q: taking an arrow away is adding it turned round.

brief.zh: 交出从 p 指向 q 的位移 d：从 p 出发走 d，正好到达 q。
brief.en: Give the move d from p to q: starting at p and moving d lands exactly on q.

hint.zh: 一支箭头乘以 −1，就掉了个头。
hint.en: An arrow times −1 is the same arrow turned round.

brief.zh: 交出从 p 走向 q、走了四分之一路程的那一点。
brief.en: Give the point a quarter of the way from p to q.

t.zh: 回头看<level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref>和<level-ref to="1-3"></level-ref>交出的点：每一个都是几支箭头各自乘一个数、再相加。这样拼出的箭头叫这几支箭头的<wiki-ref to="linear-combination"></wiki-ref>。这个形状还会反复出现，这一关把它做成一块元件，乘的数从输入接进来。
t.en: Look back at the points of <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="1-3"></level-ref>: each is a few arrows, each times a number, added up. An arrow made this way is a <wiki-ref to="linear-combination"></wiki-ref> of them. The shape will keep coming back; this level makes it one part, the numbers wired in as inputs.

after.zh: 固定 v、w，让 a、b 取遍所有的数，得到的全部点叫 v 和 w 的<wiki-ref to="span"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Hold v and w and let a and b range over every number: all the points made are the <wiki-ref to="span"></wiki-ref> of v and w.

desc.zh: 给出 a·v + b·w：v 伸缩 a 倍、w 伸缩 b 倍，再相加。
desc.en: Gives a·v + b·w: v scaled by a and w by b, then added.

brief.zh: 交出 a·v + b·w。
brief.en: Give a·v + b·w.

t.zh: 平面上的格子由两支单位箭头画出：î = (1, 0)，ĵ = (0, 1)。说一点是 (3, 2)，意思是 3 支 î 加 2 支 ĵ。
t.en: The grid of the plane is drawn by two unit arrows, î = (1, 0) and ĵ = (0, 1). To call a point (3, 2) is to say 3 of î and 2 of ĵ.

t.zh: 换两支箭头 b₁、b₂ 来画格子，同一对数就指向另一点。这两支箭头叫一组<wiki-ref to="basis"></wiki-ref>，这对数叫那一点在这组基下的<wiki-ref to="coordinates"></wiki-ref>。坐标是一个向量，<part-ref to="part:entry"></part-ref>取出它的一个分量。
t.en: Draw the grid with two other arrows b₁ and b₂, and the same pair of numbers points somewhere else. The two arrows are a <wiki-ref to="basis"></wiki-ref>, and the pair is the point's <wiki-ref to="coordinates"></wiki-ref> in it. Coordinates are a vector; <part-ref to="part:entry"></part-ref> takes out one of its entries.

after.zh: 同一点换一组基，坐标跟着变；坐标总是每支基箭头用了几倍。
after.en: Change the basis and a point's coordinates change; they always say how many of each basis arrow it takes.

brief.zh: 坐标 c 是按基 b₁、b₂ 写的，交出它所指的那一点（按 î、ĵ 写）。
brief.en: The coordinates c are in the basis b₁, b₂; give the point they name, written in î and ĵ.

t.zh: 把整个平面绕原点逆时针转四分之一圈，每一支箭头都跟着转。<part-ref to="part:vec"></part-ref>把几个数从上到下排成一个向量，配上<part-ref to="part:num"></part-ref>，就能写出一支固定的箭头。
t.en: Turn the whole plane a quarter turn anticlockwise about the origin, and every arrow turns with it. <part-ref to="part:vec"></part-ref> stacks numbers into a vector; with <part-ref to="part:num"></part-ref> it writes down a fixed arrow.

after.zh: 转动之后，格线仍然平行且等距，原点不动：这样的变换叫<wiki-ref to="linear-transformation"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: After the turn the grid lines are still parallel and evenly spaced, and the origin stays put: such a map is a <wiki-ref to="linear-transformation"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 交出 v 绕原点逆时针转四分之一圈后的箭头。
brief.en: Give v turned a quarter turn anticlockwise about the origin.

hint.zh: 先看 î 和 ĵ 各转到了哪里。
hint.en: First see where î and ĵ each turn to.

hint.zh: v 是几支 î 加几支 ĵ；转过去以后，这句话还成立吗？
hint.en: v is so many of î plus so many of ĵ; after the turn, does that still hold?

t.zh: 这一次平面不转，而是横着推：x 轴上的点不动，越往上的点推得越远，ĵ 被推到 (k, 1)。推多远由输入 k 决定。
t.en: This time the plane is not turned but pushed sideways: points on the x-axis stay put, points higher up move further, and ĵ is pushed to (k, 1). How far is the input k.

after.en: A map like this is a <wiki-ref to="shear"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 交出 v 被推过之后的箭头。
brief.en: Give v after the push.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-6"></level-ref>和<level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref>各自接好了 î、ĵ 的落点；换一个变换，板就得重接。把两个落点并排写成一张数表，当作一个值在线上传：这张表叫<wiki-ref to="matrix"></wiki-ref>，第一列是 î 的落点，第二列是 ĵ 的落点。下图的矩阵把格子推歪了。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-6"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref> each wired in where î and ĵ land; another map means wiring the board again. Write the two landing places side by side as one table and send it down a wire as one value: the table is a <wiki-ref to="matrix"></wiki-ref>, its first column where î lands and its second where ĵ lands. The matrix below pushes the grid aslant.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:column"></part-ref>从矩阵里取出一列。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:column"></part-ref> takes one column out of a matrix.

after.zh: 这个运算记作 Mx，叫<wiki-ref to="matrix-vector-product"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: The operation is written Mx: the <wiki-ref to="matrix-vector-product"></wiki-ref>.

desc.zh: 给出矩阵 M 把向量 x 送到的那一点 Mx。
desc.en: Gives the point Mx that the matrix M sends the vector x to.

brief.zh: 交出矩阵 M 所表示的变换把 x 送到的那一点。
brief.en: Give the point that the map of the matrix M sends x to.

t.zh: 反过来，说清一个变换，也就能写出它的矩阵。<part-ref to="part:join"></part-ref>把几个向量从左到右并排成矩阵，每个向量是一列。
t.en: The other way round: a map said in words can be written as its matrix. <part-ref to="part:join"></part-ref> sets vectors side by side, left to right, each a column.

after.zh: 主对角线以外全是 0 的方阵叫<wiki-ref to="diagonal-matrix"></wiki-ref>：它只沿坐标轴伸缩。
after.en: A square matrix that is 0 off its main diagonal is a <wiki-ref to="diagonal-matrix"></wiki-ref>: it only stretches along the axes.

brief.zh: î 不动、ĵ 推到 (k, 1)：交出这个剪切的矩阵。
brief.en: î stays and ĵ goes to (k, 1): give the matrix of this shear.

brief.zh: 交出横向伸缩 a 倍、纵向伸缩 b 倍的变换的矩阵。
brief.en: Give the matrix of the map that stretches by a across and by b up.

t.zh: 两个变换接连作用：先 B，再 A。每一支箭头都要经过两次变换。
t.en: Two maps one after the other: first B, then A. Every arrow goes through two maps.

after.zh: 先 B 后 A 写作 A(Bx)：后作用的写在左边，和函数的复合一样。
after.en: First B, then A is written A(Bx): the map applied last stands on the left, as with composed functions.

brief.zh: 交出 x 先经 B、再经 A 变换后的落点。
brief.en: Give where x lands after B and then A.

t.zh: <level-ref to="2-3"></level-ref>里每支箭头都走了两遍变换。两个线性变换接连作用，格线仍然平行等距，原点仍然不动，所以合起来也是一个线性变换，也有它的矩阵。
t.en: In <level-ref to="2-3"></level-ref> every arrow went through two maps. Two linear maps one after the other keep the grid lines parallel and evenly spaced and the origin still: together they are one linear map, with a matrix of its own.

after.zh: 这就是<wiki-ref to="matrix-product"></wiki-ref>：AB 表示先作用 B、再作用 A。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="matrix-product"></wiki-ref>: AB means B first, then A.

desc.zh: 给出先作用 B、再作用 A 的变换的矩阵 AB。
desc.en: Gives AB, the matrix of the map that applies B and then A.

brief.zh: 交出先 B、再 A 这个变换的矩阵 AB。
brief.en: Give AB, the matrix of B followed by A.

hint.zh: 它的第一列是 î 最后的落点。
hint.en: Its first column is where î ends up.

t.zh: 两个数相乘不管先后。两个变换呢？
t.en: Multiplying two numbers does not care which comes first. What about two maps?

after.zh: 一般 AB ≠ BA：矩阵乘法不满足交换律。两个非零矩阵的乘积也可能是零矩阵。
after.en: In general AB ≠ BA: the matrix product does not commute. Two nonzero matrices may even multiply to the zero matrix.

brief.zh: 同时交出 AB 和 BA。
brief.en: Give both AB and BA.

t.zh: 同一个变换连做三次。
t.en: One map, done three times over.

after.zh: (AA)A 与 A(AA) 相等：矩阵乘法满足结合律，A³ 不必加括号。
after.en: (AA)A equals A(AA): the matrix product is associative, so A³ needs no brackets.

brief.zh: 交出 A 连做三次的矩阵 A³。
brief.en: Give A³, the matrix of A done three times.

t.zh: 看 î、ĵ 围成的单位正方形被变换成什么：一个平行四边形。格线变换后仍然平行等距，每一格都变成同样大的平行四边形，所以任何图形的面积都放大同一个倍数。
t.en: See what the unit square on î and ĵ becomes: a parallelogram. The grid lines stay parallel and evenly spaced, so every cell becomes a parallelogram of the same size, and every shape's area grows by the same factor.

t.zh: 平面翻了面（î 转到 ĵ 的顺时针一侧）时，这个倍数记为负。这个带符号的倍数叫矩阵的<wiki-ref to="determinant"></wiki-ref>。<part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref>对两个数做加、减、乘、除。
t.en: When the plane is turned over (î ending up clockwise of ĵ), the factor is counted negative. This signed factor is the matrix's <wiki-ref to="determinant"></wiki-ref>. <part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref> adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides two numbers.

after.zh: 行列式为 0，平面被压扁成一条直线，甚至一个点。
after.en: A determinant of 0 means the plane is squashed onto a line, or even a point.

desc.zh: 给出 2 × 2 矩阵 M 的行列式：它把面积放大的倍数，翻面时为负。
desc.en: Gives the determinant of the 2 × 2 matrix M: the factor it scales area by, negative when it turns the plane over.

brief.zh: M 是对角矩阵，交出它的行列式。
brief.en: M is a diagonal matrix: give its determinant.

brief.zh: 交出任意 2 × 2 矩阵 M 的行列式。
brief.en: Give the determinant of any 2 × 2 matrix M.

t.zh: 这一次 M 不再只沿坐标轴伸缩。
t.en: This time M does more than stretch along the axes.

hint.zh: 剪切把正方形推歪，面积却没有变。
hint.en: A shear pushes the square aslant, yet its area does not change.

hint.zh: 把平行四边形沿一条边推回长方形，看留下了哪些量。
hint.en: Push the parallelogram back into a rectangle along one of its sides, and see which quantities are left.

t.zh: 先 B 后 A：面积先被 B 放大，再被 A 放大。
t.en: First B, then A: area is scaled by B, then by A.

after.zh: det(AB) = det A · det B：两个倍数相乘。
after.en: det(AB) = det A · det B: the two factors multiply.

brief.zh: 交出先 B、再 A 这个变换把面积放大的倍数（翻面时为负）。
brief.en: Give the factor by which B followed by A scales area (negative if it turns the plane over).

t.zh: 三点 p、q、r 围成一个三角形。沿 p → q → r 绕行是逆时针时，面积记为正，顺时针时记为负：这叫有向面积。
t.en: Three points p, q, r make a triangle. Its area counts positive when p → q → r runs anticlockwise and negative when clockwise: its signed area.

after.zh: 有向面积为 0，三点在同一条直线上。
after.en: A signed area of 0 means the three points lie on one line.

brief.zh: 交出三角形 pqr 的有向面积。
brief.en: Give the signed area of the triangle pqr.

hint.zh: 把三角形平移，让 p 落到原点。
hint.en: Slide the triangle so that p lands on the origin.

hint.zh: 三角形是平行四边形的一半。
hint.en: A triangle is half a parallelogram.

t.zh: 到这里为止，都是知道 x，求它的落点 Ax。反过来，知道落点 b，原来的 x 在哪里？这就是解<wiki-ref to="linear-system"></wiki-ref> Ax = b。只要 A 不把平面压扁（det A ≠ 0），答案只有一个。
t.en: So far x was known and its landing place Ax was wanted. The other way round: given where it landed, b, where was x? That is solving the <wiki-ref to="linear-system"></wiki-ref> Ax = b. As long as A does not squash the plane (det A ≠ 0), there is exactly one answer.

after.zh: 用行列式之比求解的方法叫<wiki-ref to="cramer-rule"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Solving by a ratio of determinants is <wiki-ref to="cramer-rule"></wiki-ref>.

desc.zh: 给出满足 Ax = b 的 x（det A ≠ 0）。
desc.en: Gives the x with Ax = b (det A ≠ 0).

brief.zh: 交出满足 Ax = b 的 x（这一关的 A 的行列式都不为 0）。
brief.en: Give the x with Ax = b (every A here has a nonzero determinant).

hint.zh: x 的第一个分量，等于 x 和 ĵ 张成的平行四边形的有向面积。
hint.en: The first entry of x is the signed area of the parallelogram on x and ĵ.

hint.zh: 这个平行四边形经 A 变换后，变成 b 和 A 的第二列张成的平行四边形，面积放大了 det A 倍。
hint.en: Under A that parallelogram becomes the one on b and the second column of A, its area scaled by det A.

t.zh: 平面上一条直线可以写成 ax + by = c，记下三个数 (a, b, c) 就是这条直线。两条直线不平行时，交于一点。
t.en: A line in the plane can be written ax + by = c, so three numbers (a, b, c) are the line. Two lines that are not parallel meet in one point.

after.zh: 求两条直线的交点，就是解一个两元一次方程组。
after.en: Where two lines meet is the solution of a system of two linear equations in two unknowns.

brief.zh: 两条直线 l₁、l₂ 各以 (a, b, c) 给出，交出它们的交点。
brief.en: The lines l₁ and l₂ are each given as (a, b, c); give the point where they meet.

value.zh: 把两个形状相同的向量逐个分量相加：画出来，第二支箭头接在第一支的箭头尖上，和从起点指到终点。
value.en: Adds two vectors of one shape entry by entry: drawn, the second arrow starts at the tip of the first, and the sum runs from the start to the end.

value.zh: 数 k 乘向量 v 的每个分量：箭头沿自己所在的直线伸缩 k 倍，k 为负时掉头。
value.en: Multiplies every entry of the vector v by the number k: the arrow stretches or shrinks k times along its own line, and turns round when k is negative.
Gives the number it is set to.

desc.zh: 给出向量从上往下数的第 i 个分量，一个数。
desc.en: Gives entry i of the vector, counting from the top: a number.

desc.zh: 把接进来的数从上到下排成一个向量；最后一个口可以不接。
desc.en: Stacks the numbers wired in, top to bottom, into a vector; the last port may be left unwired.

desc.zh: 给出矩阵从左往右数的第 j 列，一个向量。
desc.en: Gives column j of the matrix, counting from the left: a vector.

desc.zh: 把接进来的向量从左到右并排成一个矩阵，每个向量是一列；后两个口可以不接。
desc.en: Sets the vectors wired in side by side, left to right, as the columns of a matrix; the last two ports may be left unwired.

desc.zh: 对两个数做所选的运算。
desc.en: Works out the chosen operation on two numbers.

about.zh: a 除以 b；b 为 0 时没有结果。
about.en: a divided by b; there is no result when b is 0.

value.zh: 从相加和伸缩两个动作起步，亲手搭出矩阵、矩阵乘法、行列式和解方程的元件，看清每一个矩阵怎样推动整张格子。
value.en: Starting from adding and stretching arrows, build the parts for matrices, the matrix product, determinants and solving equations yourself, and see how every matrix carries the whole grid along.

question.zh: 只会相加和伸缩，能拼出哪些箭头？
question.en: Adding and stretching alone: which arrows can they make?

question.zh: 每换一个变换就重接一遍板；能不能把变换本身当作一个值？
question.en: Each new map means wiring the board again: can a map itself be a value?

question.zh: 一个变换把面积放大了多少倍？
question.en: By how much does a map scale area?

body.zh: 既有大小又有方向的量。画出来是从原点出发的一支箭头；写出来是一列数，从上到下是箭头尖的各个坐标，如 (2, 1)。教材把它写成一列，叫列向量。
body.en: A quantity with a size and a direction. Drawn, an arrow from the origin; written, a column of numbers, top to bottom the coordinates of its tip, such as (2, 1). Textbooks write it as a column, a column vector.

body.zh: 几个数排成的一列有多少个数，向量就是几维的：平面上的箭头是二维向量，空间里的是三维向量。
body.en: How many numbers the column holds is the vector's dimension: arrows in the plane are two-dimensional vectors, those in space three-dimensional.

body.zh: 两个维数相同的向量逐个分量相加得到的向量。画出来，第二支箭头接在第一支的箭头尖上，和从起点指到终点。
body.en: The vector made by adding two vectors of one dimension entry by entry. Drawn, the second arrow starts at the tip of the first, and the sum runs from the start to the end.

body.zh: 相加不管先后：u + v = v + u。
body.en: The order does not matter: u + v = v + u.

body.zh: 一个数 k 乘向量的每个分量，得到 k 倍的向量。箭头沿自己所在的直线伸长或缩短为 k 倍；k 为负时掉头，k 为 0 时缩成原点。
body.en: Every entry of a vector times one number k, giving k times the vector. The arrow stretches or shrinks k times along its own line; it turns round when k is negative and shrinks to the origin when k is 0.

body.zh: 和向量相对，单独一个数也叫标量。
body.en: Set against vectors, a single number is also called a scalar.

body.zh: 几个向量各乘一个数再相加：a·v + b·w。乘的数叫组合系数。
body.en: A few vectors, each times a number, added up: a·v + b·w. The numbers are its coefficients.

body.zh: 几个向量的全部线性组合合在一起，叫它们张成的集合。平面上两支不共线的箭头张成整个平面；共线的两支只张成一条过原点的直线。
body.en: All the linear combinations of a few vectors together are their span. Two arrows of the plane not on one line span the whole plane; two on one line span only a line through the origin.

body.zh: 用来度量整个空间的一组向量：空间里每一点都恰好有一种办法写成它们的线性组合。平面上任意两支不共线的箭头都是一组基；î = (1, 0)、ĵ = (0, 1) 是最常用的一组，叫标准基。
body.en: A set of vectors to measure the whole space by: every point of the space is a linear combination of them in exactly one way. Any two arrows of the plane not on one line are a basis; î = (1, 0) and ĵ = (0, 1) are the usual one, the standard basis.

body.zh: 一点写成某组基的线性组合时，那几个组合系数。同一点在不同的基下坐标不同。
body.en: The coefficients when a point is written as a linear combination of a basis. One point has different coordinates in different bases.

body.zh: 把空间里的每支箭头送到另一支箭头的变换，并且格线变换后仍然平行且等距、原点不动。用式子说：它保持相加和数乘，T(u + v) = T(u) + T(v)，T(k·v) = k·T(v)。
body.en: A map sending every arrow of a space to an arrow, keeping grid lines parallel and evenly spaced and the origin still. As equations: it keeps sums and scalar multiples, T(u + v) = T(u) + T(v) and T(k·v) = k·T(v).

body.zh: 转动、剪切、沿轴伸缩、关于过原点的直线翻转都是线性变换；平移不是，它挪动了原点。
body.en: Turns, shears, stretches along the axes and flips across a line through the origin are linear; a slide is not, since it moves the origin.

body.zh: 一条直线上的点不动、其余的点平行于这条直线推动、推的距离和到这条直线的距离成正比的线性变换。
body.en: A linear map that keeps the points of one line still and pushes the others along it, each by a distance in proportion to how far it is from the line.

body.zh: 排成若干行、若干列的一张数表。m 行 n 列的矩阵叫 m × n 矩阵；行数和列数相等时叫方阵。
body.en: A table of numbers in rows and columns. One of m rows and n columns is an m × n matrix; with as many rows as columns it is square.

body.zh: 一个线性变换的矩阵，第 j 列是第 j 支标准基箭头的落点。所以写下一个矩阵，就是写下一个线性变换。
body.en: In the matrix of a linear map, column j is where the j-th standard basis arrow lands. Writing down a matrix is writing down a linear map.

body.zh: 矩阵 M 所表示的线性变换把向量 x 送到的向量，记作 Mx。M 的列数必须等于 x 的维数。
body.en: The vector that the linear map of the matrix M sends x to, written Mx. M must have as many columns as x has entries.

body.zh: 主对角线（左上到右下）以外的元素全为 0 的方阵。它把第 k 支标准基箭头伸缩为对角线上第 k 个数的倍数。主对角线上全是 1 的叫单位矩阵 I，它什么也不改变。
body.en: A square matrix with 0 everywhere off its main diagonal (top left to bottom right). It stretches the k-th standard basis arrow by the k-th number on the diagonal. The one with 1s down the diagonal is the identity matrix I, which changes nothing.

body.zh: AB 是先作用 B、再作用 A 的线性变换的矩阵。A 的列数必须等于 B 的行数。
body.en: AB is the matrix of the linear map that applies B and then A. A must have as many columns as B has rows.

body.zh: 矩阵乘法满足结合律，(AB)C = A(BC)，但一般不满足交换律：AB 和 BA 可以不同。
body.en: The product is associative, (AB)C = A(BC), but in general not commutative: AB and BA may differ.

body.zh: 方阵 A 的行列式 det A（也写作 |A|）是它所表示的线性变换把面积（在空间里是体积）放大的倍数；变换把平面翻面时取负。
body.en: The determinant det A (also written |A|) of a square matrix A is the factor by which its linear map scales area (volume, in space), negative when the map turns the plane over.

body.zh: det A = 0 当且仅当这个变换把空间压扁到更低的维数。
body.en: det A = 0 exactly when the map squashes space into fewer dimensions.

body.zh: 几个一次方程联立，例如 3x₁ − 2x₂ = 12，2x₁ + x₂ = 1。把系数排成矩阵 A、常数排成向量 b，就写成 Ax = b：找那支被 A 送到 b 的向量 x。
body.en: Several linear equations taken together, such as 3x₁ − 2x₂ = 12 and 2x₁ + x₂ = 1. With the coefficients as a matrix A and the constants as a vector b, it reads Ax = b: find the vector x that A sends to b.

body.zh: det A ≠ 0 时，Ax = b 的唯一解的第 k 个分量等于 det Aₖ / det A，其中 Aₖ 是把 A 的第 k 列换成 b 得到的矩阵。
body.en: When det A ≠ 0, the k-th entry of the one solution of Ax = b is det Aₖ / det A, where Aₖ is A with its k-th column replaced by b.

body.zh: det A = 0 时法则不能用：方程组或者无解，或者有无穷多解。
body.en: When det A = 0 the rule does not apply: the system has either no solution or infinitely many.

value.zh: 从相加和数乘两块元件起步，把箭头拼成新的箭头。
value.en: Starting from Add and Scale, put arrows together into new ones.
Gives the number it is set to.

value.zh: 数 k 乘向量 v 的每个分量：箭头沿原来的直线伸长或缩短 k 倍，k 为负时掉头。
value.en: Multiplies every entry of the vector v by the number k: the arrow stretches or shrinks k times along its own line, and turns round when k is negative.

value.zh: 把两个形状相同的向量逐个分量相加：几何上，第二支箭头接在第一支的箭头尖上，和从起点指到终点。
value.en: Adds two vectors of one shape entry by entry: drawn, the second arrow starts at the tip of the first, and the sum runs from the start to the end.

t.zh: 向量是一支有方向的箭头，也是一列数。两支箭头<wiki-ref to="sum"></wiki-ref>，就是后一支接在前一支的箭头尖上。
t.en: A vector is an arrow with a direction, and a column of numbers. Two arrows make a <wiki-ref to="sum"></wiki-ref> when the second starts at the tip of the first.

brief.zh: 交出 u、v、w 三支箭头首尾相接后的总位移。
brief.en: Give the whole move of u, v and w laid tip to tail.

showcase.zh: 第一次往板上放元件、接线
showcase.en: the first parts placed and wired on a board

t.zh: 同样的三段路走两遍。
t.en: The same three legs, walked twice.

brief.zh: 交出把 u、v、w 走两遍的总位移。
brief.en: Give the whole move of walking u, v and w twice.

body.zh: 两个向量逐个分量相加；画出来，后一支箭头接在前一支的箭头尖上。
body.en: Two vectors added entry by entry; drawn, the second arrow starts at the tip of the first.
